scope.recursive_boundary: RuleRef closes over a finite Named(RuleId) binder and never unfolds the referenced rule root
scope.record_boundary: a nominal record is the complete root of exactly one rule; only explicitly named slots enter its semantic field list

inference_rules.preservation: the verifier requires the exact syntax/certificate pair and exact interned result
the terminal retains its original-input byte span
the verifier compares the referenced and certified RuleId without traversing the recursive root

inference_rules.preservation: certificate child identities and order must equal the program

premises: each branch has a verified TypeId in source order
inference_rules.preservation: certificate branch identities and order must equal the program

premises: analysis later rejects a nullable repeated child
inference_rules.preservation: the verifier requires the exact child

premises: owner is the unique direct rule-root owner
certificate slots exactly equal program slots in source order

inference_rules.result: SemanticType::Record { owner, fields: retained fields only }
inference_rules.preservation: discarded slots remain recognition premises but are absent from the semantic field list; retained field order is preserved
the action-free transform is declarative metadata and cannot change the semantic type

certificate_encoding.version_law: the private local-index/public-capability split preserves the already-compact v2 wire shape; representation-only authority and opacity changes do not justify a schema-number increase

verifier.invocation: compile_module invokes verify after solve and before analysis/lowering
checks: node and rule derivation counts and identities are exact
the type arena contains no duplicate semantic witness
all private TypeIx, RuleIx, FieldIx, NodeIx, and TransformIx references are in bounds under the solution's exact program Revision; every public view rebrands them with that Revision
semantic child references are acyclic except through Named(RuleId)
every certificate matches its exact NodeKind and recomputes its exact result
every field descriptor agrees with its nominal owner and child
every arena member is reachable from a node or named rule derivation
verifier.failure: typed DiagnosticCode::InternalInvariant; no fallback type is substituted

identity_authority.public_capability: NodeId, RuleId, FieldId, TransformId, TypeId, SccId, and PlanNodeId carry the exact full Revision plus a private u32 local ordinal; NodeId is 36 bytes on the audited target
identity_authority.private_storage: compiler arenas and carrier rows store four-byte NodeIx, RuleIx, FieldIx, TransformIx, TypeIx, SccIx, and PlanNodeIx values rather than repeated public capabilities
identity_authority.lookup_law: every public carrier lookup rejects a foreign revision before indexing, including a foreign ID whose local ordinal is in range
identity_authority.determinism: separately compiled identical logical path and bytes have the same Revision and their branded IDs interoperate
identity_authority.edit_law: editing away invalidates all old branded IDs; restoring identical path and bytes restores the Revision and deterministic IDs
identity_authority.remap_law: NodeRemap checks the input ID against from_revision and brands a successful result with to_revision
identity_authority.wire_law: private replay adapters serialize compact u32 carrier-local ordinals under revision-bearing carriers; serialized ordinals are not portable public lookup capabilities
identity_authority.serialization_opacity: public capability types and sealed carriers do not implement serde::Serialize; local index types, their constructors/accessors, and capability fields remain private

principality.meaning: for a fixed admitted Program, constructors determine one canonical interned structural type solution and one executable certificate per node

order_evidence.type_constraint_discovery: 16 fixed-seed permutations compare exactly with the canonical TypeSolution
order_evidence.analysis: 16 fixed-seed node/rule discovery permutations run the same dependency-first SCC schedule and compare exact AnalysisFacts; overflowing witnesses compare exact diagnostics
order_evidence.qualification: type derivation seals nodes in canonical NodeId order after constraint discovery; this is not a claim about arbitrary parallel sealing or HM unification

edit_evidence.kind: stateful edit route with deterministic full invalidation and clean-rebuild equality
edit_evidence.cases: four single-byte source states b, c, d, then restored a
edit_evidence.comparison: CompilationSession mutates its owned source, recompiles the complete immutable carrier, and every serialized stage packet equals a fresh compile of the same current bytes
edit_evidence.atomicity: reversed and out-of-bounds edit ranges leave session bytes untouched; a valid edit whose source is rejected remains the session's new source and returns typed diagnostics
edit_evidence.qualification: full invalidation is explicit; there is no incremental cache, incremental compiler, or incremental type solver in W2

accepted: recursive nominal records whose retained fields contain List(Named(rule))
rejected: structural containment cycles that do not cross Named(RuleId)
direct and mutual zero-consumption recursive cycles
repetition of every nullable child, including a bounded optional child
recursive_and_occurs_laws.resource_bound: analysis exceeding the configured synchronous fixed-point iteration limit is a typed ResourceLimit rejection

analysis_semantics.schema_lineage: v2 names the rejected full-capability epoch and is not reused; v3 adds required work_units and replaces global rounds with deterministic dependency-first component passes
analysis_semantics.overflow_law: surviving sequence, record, or descendant overflow rejects with DiagnosticCode::MinimumConsumptionOverflow at the exact origin span; overflow can still refine to a smaller finite successful choice
analysis_semantics.schedule: DependencySolution components are visited in dependency-first order; simultaneously ready components use local SccIx as a stable tie breaker and rule discovery permutations only affect a deterministic within-component rank
analysis_semantics.iteration_law: acyclic components take one pass; the selected recursive fixture rejects at analysis_iterations=1 and converges in exactly two passes at 2
analysis_semantics.work_law: analysis_work is charged before every terminal or regex initialization, during rule-range and component scheduling, and before every node/rule component pass; accepted AnalysisFacts records the exact work_units charge
analysis_semantics.scaling_witness: singleton acyclic reference chains at 8, 64, and 256 rules use exactly seven work units per rule; the exact cap passes and one less is a typed ResourceLimit rejection
analysis_semantics.determinism: 16 fixed-seed discovery permutations produce byte-identical accepted facts or byte-identical MinimumConsumptionOverflow diagnostics
analysis_semantics.public_api: AnalysisFacts::iterations and AnalysisFacts::work_units are public, and all returned row/view/iterator types are publicly re-exported under crate-level deny(unnameable_types)

record_laws.syntax: %{ field: postfix, ~postfix } as one complete rule root
record_laws.retention: only explicitly named fields receive FieldId and semantic RecordFieldType
record_laws.discard: a ~slot remains in Program and LoweringPlan recognition order but has no semantic field
record_laws.empty_record: SemanticType::Record with its owner and an empty field vector
record_laws.duplicates: duplicate retained names in one record are rejected at the second name span
record_laws.lowering: PlanNode and LoweredRule retain TypeId; LoweredField retains owner, source slot, child, name, and semantic TypeId

optimizer_disposition.direct_algorithms: authoritative, including the dependency-first SCC analysis worklist
optimizer_disposition.egraph: not present in the selected W2 compiler slice; no bounded equality-island witness requested activation
optimizer_disposition.csp: not present in the selected W2 compiler slice; no coupled global-choice witness requested activation
optimizer_disposition.claim: absence and direct-default disposition, not a performance or novelty claim

checked_carrier_lookup_contract.law: same-index and out-of-bounds identities from another revision are rejected at every public lookup; identical rebuilds interoperate; edit-away invalidates and edit-back restores; replay IDs remain numeric local ordinals

compiler_colocated_unit_laws.distribution: source 1; syntax/remap 2; dependency 1; type 3; analysis 4; lowering 1; event 1
compiler_colocated_unit_laws.analysis_repair_additions: minimum-consumption lattice law and overflow-diagnostic permutation law

cases: private local index types cannot be imported
sealed Program cannot be serialized directly
public NodeId cannot be serialized directly
private local accessor cannot be called
private capability fields prevent destructuring and forging

limitations: This artifact does not promote broader full type resolution beyond the sealed first-order W2 grammar-shape language.
The transform rule proves type identity only; it does not execute or type a host callback.
Constraint-discovery permutation, dependency-first SCC scheduling, and CompilationSession full-invalidation equality do not establish an incremental compiler.
